##### Project general facts

SODIC East is a large master-planned community designed with a low building footprint and divided into distinct neighbourhoods planned around outdoor living. It offers fully finished homes across Hazel, with standalone villas, townhouses, family houses and residences, and Oak Residences, a collection of two and three-bedroom apartments and sky penthouses set around a central park.

A wide green spine and The Ravine, a vast green expanse with walking paths and open views, run through the community, joined by landscaped parks, garden nodes, jogging and cycling lanes, barbecue areas and children's play areas. SODIC Sports Club brings sports academies, fitness, wellness and social spaces, while the community also includes the Finnish British School, a commercial district with offices, clinics, retail and dining, a community mall, a mosque and neighbourhood services.

Homes come fully finished, with porcelain or ceramic flooring, fitted kitchens and quality sanitary fixtures. Villas and townhouses are arranged over several levels with reception and dining areas, private gardens, roof terraces and penthouse floors, while apartments feature spacious reception areas, terraces and private gardens for ground-floor units. Residences come unfurnished, ready for owners to personalise.

##### Parking

Private parking.

##### Location description and benefits

New Heliopolis is a growing residential district in East Cairo, positioned between the Cairo–Suez Road and the Cairo–Ismailia Road and directly adjacent to El Shorouk City. The area combines open desert landscapes with planned green communities and offers easy access to New Cairo and the New Administrative Capital.

Main highways and the Regional Ring Road connect the district to Cairo International Airport, Downtown Cairo and the wider metropolitan area, with monorail and LRT stations within reach. Nearby El Shorouk and New Cairo provide established shopping, dining, international schools and healthcare facilities.

East Cairo is one of the most active growth corridors in the country, driven by government investment around the New Administrative Capital and steady demand from families and professionals moving east. The area appeals to both end users and investors seeking long-term capital growth and rental demand.
